body: Quick pass (UMA) @ 075a9c6e: re-ran the full quick gate on the final head since the author re-ran only the affected suites: app suites (336 s) + ui suites (173 s), 0 failed. Clippy clean per the author, body complete. Flagged ready; a feat, merges at the next cut. #898's PR will stack on this branch.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 075a9c6e8d17bdee38b713aac341e423ea257d81 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Reviewed at head 075a9c6e, trial-merged with current origin/main (clean, no conflicts).

**What looks good**
- One command per import: `ImportTools::with_mode` plans a `Vec<Step>` (Add / Change / Remove) and `apply`/`invert` run it as one history entry. Undo walks the steps in reverse (`crates/app/src/commands/tool_import.rs`), and Replace removals use `DeleteTool`, which restores number, body and cutter on undo.
- Update keeps the entity and the controller number (`put`, `tool_import.rs`), and the ops that use the tool go Stale through the same stamp `ChangeTool` uses. Pinned by `update_changes_in_place_keeps_identity_and_number_and_stales_ops`.
- Replace refuses by name before anything is applied when an operation uses a tool the library lacks (`replace_refuses_to_remove_a_tool_an_operation_uses`). So no dangling tool reference is left.
- Update and Replace run the same gates as `ChangeTool` (torch, retype, body fit, cutter fit) and refuse a name that is not a tool.
- Add: I compared the old and new code. The branch conditions reduce to the same outcomes (skip identical, rename a different duplicate, duplicate-in-library refusal), and `summary()` prints the same text for Add. The default is `ImportMode::Add`.
- MCP `import_tool_library` takes an optional `mode` (schema enum add/update/replace), and `cam.importTools` takes the same mode. Both call `ImportTools::with_mode`, so they match the GUI command.
- UI: the mode combo and hover text are plain English; no world calls in the UI.
- No snapshot PNG changed. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in non-test code; the `expect` calls are in test files only.

**Local results (trial merge with main)**
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test tool_import_modes` | 9 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp` | 14 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs` is already about 1944 lines and grows by 22 here. This is over the 400-line guide, but it was already over it before this PR.
2. Replace checks operations (`op.tool == name`) but not other references to a tool name. I did not find any other reference type in the diff. Worth a glance if a tool can be named elsewhere, such as a holder or setup.
3. Not exercised: the UI itself (no GUI run, by rule), and Replace with an op that uses a tool that is only in the document's "removed" set, beyond the existing test.
4. `docs/decisions/899-tool-import-modes.md` is present. The body carries `Changelog:` and `Fixes` text, as the review checklist asks.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
